docket_entries.description: ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE SUBJECT TO POSSIBLE MOTION TO RECONSIDERATION. PLAINTIFF YUAN-JIUN SUNG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MENGDI PAN IS NOT PRESENT. PLAINTIFF REQUESTS TO AMEND SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAS BEEN DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO NOTICE OF REQUEST TO AMEND SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT HAS BEEN GIVEN TO DEFENDANT PRIOR TO TODAY'S HEARING. PLAINTIFF STATED SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT AMOUNT HAS BEEN PAID BY THE DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: RONALD QUIDACHAY; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE SUBJECT TO MOTION TO RECONSIDERATION. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,063.00 FILED BY SUNG, YUAN-JIUN AKA DAVID SUNG AS TO DEFENDANT PAN, MENGDI AKA BIANCA PAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-31-2022 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $278.00) SERVED AUG-05-2022, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT PAN, MENGDI AKA BIANCA PAN

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-31-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-22-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF YUAN-JIUN SUNG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MENGDI PAN IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $300.00 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT TO MAKE PAYMENT OF $300.00 VIA VENMO BY SEPTEMBER 9, 2022. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE SEPTEMBER 22, 2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE AS AGREED, $100.00 PENALTY FINE WILL BE ASSESSED AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ISSUED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU / W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
